summary: Import-time dropper fetches and executes attacker-controlled binary from obfuscated Cloudflare Workers hosts
details: On require of the package, _runtime.js selects an OS/arch-specific payload (linux_x64, linux_arm64, darwin, win32), downloads a binary from string-split-obfuscated *.workers.dev mirrors (oob-worker.cf103-070.workers.dev, oob-worker.cf100-416.workers.dev, oob-worker.cf101-adf.workers.dev, oob-worker.cf99-9b3.workers.dev) with a DNS TXT-record fallback under sdk.dl.wel1.ru / ext.dl.wel1.ru / pkg.dl.wel1.ru / net.dl.wel1.ru that base64-decodes assembled chunks, writes the bytes to /tmp/.cache_<hex> or %TEMP%\dotnet_diag_<hex>.exe, chmods 0755, and spawns the file detached via /bin/sh -c or cmd.exe /c start. Host strings are assembled via array.join() to evade static analysis, and cover-story naming ('.analytics_state', 'dotnet_diag_', 'telemetry' comments) is layered over the dropper. The declared purpose of the package (a BNPL payment popup) does not require importing or executing a fetched native binary.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
